title: 同一纸面的学习书桌

sources: Generated from the user's product direction; no reference images supplied.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop message-inline learning workspace design for the Chinese personal companion app 在场.
Primary request: Design one beautiful, usable "同一纸面的学习书桌" embedded in a conversation. The learner is working on ONE actual calculus exercise. The layout must make the relationship among the original question, the learner's own one-line handwritten attempt, and ONE currently requested small hint perceptible at a glance. A quiet side-by-side double-paper relationship, not a dashboard or a pile of chat bubbles. The original problem occupies a narrower paper on the left; the learner's draft is the larger working paper on the right. A small warm marginal teacher annotation belongs next to the exact written line, with a subtle pencil-like linking stroke. Spacious blank writing room below with an actual textarea-like invitation and one modest send-arrow control.
Scene/backdrop: front-facing app screenshot with a restrained warm grey conversation canvas and soft window light. Paper is near-white, faint warm edges, subtle fold/shadow, a little muted gold emphasis. This is implementable UI, not a physical notebook photograph.
Text verbatim: small heading "把这一步想通"; source "示例讲义 · 第 3 页"; problem label "这一题"; problem "求不定积分"; clear mathematical display "∫ x cos(x²) dx"; learner label "我想到这里"; learner's handwritten line "令 u = x²，du = 2x dx"; short teacher annotation "先把 x dx 看作一整块。它和 du 能怎样换过来？"; writing placeholder "我接下来想到的是…"; small primary action "再给一点提示"; unobtrusive text action "直接讲清楚"; tiny source access "看看原页".
Typography: excellent Chinese typesetting, readable 15–18px equivalents, real mathematical typesetting, learner line has a restrained cursive handwritten quality but remains fully legible.
Character presence: at most a soft cropped companion silhouette at the far page margin, under 8% of total space, entirely secondary to the question and student's work; no giant avatar, no speech-balloon UI.
Constraints: show only this one small hint, no final antiderivative, no complete solution, no hidden-answer panel, no answer chips, no test score, mastery meter, progress bar, badges, ability label, hint/mode/steps metadata, status dashboard, timestamps row, tool names, engineering text, or extra sections. Current teaching stance is expressed through the content and the "直接讲清楚" action, never status tags. Keep a coherent quiet paper composition with ordinary accessible controls and generous space. No background wallpaper image and no flashy gradients.
decision: Use narrower original-question paper beside a larger learner working paper; one current small teaching annotation relates to the real learner line. Keep direct explanation available. Implement as responsive CSS and real text, not a bitmap interface.
status: Design image personally inspected; runtime UI and interactions not run or verified at the user's request.
